title: Three Thousand Men
text: So Saul took three thousand chosen men from all Israel and went to look for David and his men in the region of the Rocks of the Wild Goats.

title: A Corner of the Robe
text: Then David crept up and stealthily cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.

title: The LORD's Anointed
text: The LORD forbid that I should do such a thing to my master, the LORD’s anointed.

title: My Hand Will Never Be Against You
text: May the LORD judge between you and me, … but my hand will never be against you.

title: You Will Be King
text: Now I know for sure that you will be king and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hands.

title: The Spring of En Gedi
text: And David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En-gedi.

title: Rocks of the Wild Goats
text: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.

title: In You My Soul Takes Refuge
text: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge.

title: The Distressed and Indebted
text: And all who were distressed or indebted or discontented rallied around him, and he became their leader.

title: A Flea
text: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom are you pursuing? A dead dog? A flea?
